intro: Tucked away in the dense jungles of northern Stranglethorn Vale, the Venture Co. Base Camp serves as a forward foothold for the notoriously greedy goblin syndicate. Here, hired overseers and laborers exploit the lush wilderness, focusing their efforts on harvesting timber, hunting local wildlife, and extracting valuable tumbled crystals from the nearby waterways.

p: The Venture Company is infamous across Azeroth for ruthless profiteering and complete disregard for the natural world. At this jungle base camp, steam-powered equipment and makeshift goblin shacks chew into the ancient canopy. Guarded by armed mercenaries, foremen, and field workers, the camp coordinates resource extraction throughout the surrounding valleys, paying particular interest to valuable tumbled crystals found nearby while clear-cutting any jungle that stands in their way.
